description: Fetch full details for any HackerNews item by its integer ID — works for stories, comments, Ask HN posts, Show HN posts, jobs, and polls. Returns type, title, URL, author, score, body text (HTML-stripped), comment count, child comment IDs (up to 10), and direct HN link. No auth required. Data: Hacker News (CC BY 3.0).

id.description: HackerNews item ID (integer). Works for stories, comments, jobs, polls, and poll options. Example: 48713832

name: hackernews.item.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: HackerNews Item Details
